items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: We played Los Angeles, California with this show I had

ctx.x: So he kept him a chauffeur but then he'd drive, too. And he got those tickets all over the country, and so he was barred from behind the wheel in the United States, a lot of states. He would never pay a ticket. But he'd get them all day.

I was with him in Newark, he'd get him a couple of white girls, blond, and put them in his car. And he's going down to broadcast or do something and in downtown New Jersey, he'd pull right up in the middle of the crossing and turn his car in the wrong way and get out and leave it and go upstairs. The cops would come along, 'whose car is this?' Wymanie on the-ass, you know? Must be Wymanie Harris on the-ass. And that's where he'd get his publicity. He figured if he didn't get it one way he'd get him some blonds…
